goal: Reach >=98% F1 per plan on training group homes by improving the deterministic A/B Stantec detector with GENERIC (no-hardcoding) code rules, then produce GH4/GH5 detections for manual UI correction.
hard_rules: NO HARDCODING: no page-, room-, group-home-, label-, or coordinate-specific constants/overrides. Every fix must be a reusable geometric/CV rule.
Edit ONLY app/services/stantec_detector_core.py (single source of truth; it is what the UI runs). CLI copy is a stale subset - ignore, optionally mirror at end.
Doors, door swings, wall gaps, labels, dimensions, fixtures, and the space between a door and a window cap are NOT windows.
When a dimension/measurement line crosses a window symbol, recover the underlying cap/pane evidence; do not require uninterrupted strokes.
Keep detector modular: new symbol families must not break existing ones.
After any code change run `graphify update .`.

entry_points: run_stantec(pdf, pages, outdir, dpi, group_homes, save_raw)
detector.method: deterministic-stantec v28 (geometric: wall-band -> cap/sash stroke -> pane evidence -> door/wall-space rejection)

ground_truth.rule: Take the LAST page_windows_saved event; its corrected_windows is the canonical full-page GT (58 boxes, cumulative across all 4 plans). Box format box_px=[x1,y1,x2,y2] in page_space_px. Dedupe identical boxes.
ground_truth.assign_to_plan: Bin each GT box into a group-home by which crop region (from detect_stantec_plan_regions) contains its center.

group_homes.handoff_note: For GH4/GH5: run improved detector, emit detections + overlays only. User runs+corrects via UI; no automated accuracy gate here.

metric.definition: Length + placement match. A pred is TP vs a GT box when ALL hold:
conditions: placement match: both corners align - |pred_x1-gt_x1|<=pos_tol_px AND |pred_y1-gt_y1|<=pos_tol_px AND |pred_x2-gt_x2|<=pos_tol_px AND |pred_y2-gt_y2|<=pos_tol_px (corner check also enforces short side + exact location)
metric.tolerance_note: Start at 2 px (per user). Tunable; one GT matches at most one pred (greedy nearest by total corner offset).
metric.score: F1 = 2*TP / (2*TP + FP + FN), reported per plan + macro across train set
metric.fp: detection with no GT match (includes boxes the user deleted or relabeled Door)
metric.fn: GT window with no detection match
metric.escalation: Per GH: if <target after 3 full fix+rerun cycles, lower target to 0.96, then 0.94, then -0.02 each tier; document the tier reached.

per_group_home: 1. DETECT: run detector on the GH crop using page_image_path=page_17.png (GT coordinate space).
2. SCORE: compute TP/FP/FN/F1 vs that GH's GT subset using the length+placement metric.
3. DIAGNOSE: for each FP/FN, inspect the crop region; cluster errors into a named failure PATTERN (e.g. 'door-cap gap counted as window', 'dimension line splits cap', 'vertical service cap missed').
4. ROOT-CAUSE: trace pattern to the responsible function in core; design a GENERIC rule fix.
6. RE-RUN same GH: keep change only if F1 improved.
7. REGRESSION GATE: re-run ALL train GHs; macro-F1 must not drop. If it drops, revise or revert.
8. LOG: append a learning entry; update loop_state.json.
loop.cross_validation: After all 4 GHs pass their tier: re-run the unified detector across GH1/2/3/26 once more; confirm macro-F1 holds with zero per-GH regression.
loop.handoff: Then run GH4 + GH5, save overlays for user UI correction.

learnings.entry_format:
## <pattern-name>
- Symptom (FP/FN):
- Root cause:
- Generic rule applied:
- Function(s):
- Before/After F1:
learnings.split_rule: When a learnings file exceeds 300 lines, start docs/solutions/LOOP_LEARNINGS_2.md (then _3, ...). Also drop category-specific fixes into docs/solutions/<category>/ per existing convention.
learnings.mistake_log: After each iteration, record what was tried and failed (and why) so it is not repeated.

token_discipline: Read only the crop region and the specific function under repair, not whole files repeatedly.
Keep running state in loop_state.json + LOOP_LEARNINGS.md; do not re-derive prior findings in context.
Compress diagnoses to pattern names; cite file:line instead of pasting code.
done_definition: All 4 train GHs at their accuracy tier (>=98% where achievable) with zero cross-validation regression, learnings + state files current, graphify updated, and GH4/GH5 detection overlays generated for manual correction.
